newsitem.title: USA: Explosion goes off outside California courthouse.
newsitem.headline: Explosion goes off outside California courthouse.

text.p: A bomb exploded early Thursday outside a county courthouse in Vallejo near San Francisco, blasting out windows from several nearby buildings, but there were no immediate reports of injuries, CNN said.
Journalist Craig Cannon told CNN he arrived at the site only minutes after the explosion and he had seen no ambulances, although there was apparently extensive damage.
